name: Single slit
description: Single slit for edge-diffraction (UTD) work. A small one-sided square light (3 cm, radiance 10000) at z = 0.5 faces an opaque black screen at z = 0. The screen has a vertical slit 5 cm wide and 80 cm long; its two long edges are knife edges (zero-thickness half-planes). A white Lambertian wall at z = -1 receives the light. Geometric optics gives a fully lit 9 cm strip inside a 21 cm penumbra and darkness beyond; diffraction adds fringes and light inside the geometric shadow. At a design wavelength of 5 mm the Fresnel number w^2 / (lambda L1 L2 / (L1 + L2)) is 1.5 and the light's transverse coherence width at the slit, lambda L1 / a, is 1.7 slit widths; scale all lengths with the wavelength. The camera stands between the screen and the wall, facing the wall.
